raw.rationale: Tandutinib is a type III RTK inhibitor with potent activity against FLT3, KIT, and PDGFR, so selective killing is most plausible in lineages with strong dependence on these kinases, notably KIT-driven GIST (not in the listed lineages), PDGFR-driven subsets, and FLT3-mutant AML (not listed); among the listed solid lineages, KIT/PDGFR dependencies are rare and no lineage is expected to show a mean log2 fold change ≤ -0.5 with a ≥0.5 separation from all others at 2.5 µM.
